name: A Game Started From Inside A Game Keeps Its Mode And Leaves The Daily (restart, next, level picker)
note: Written with the gate on 2026-10-06. The first three put back, one button at a time, the bug both halves of the gate were written for; the last two break the follow-up itself.

mutations.name: Restart on the game-over card goes back to starting with a level only
mutations.why: The original shape: a Survival player who ran out of mistakes and pressed Restart got a Classic game with a clock counting up.

mutations.name: Next puzzle on the victory card goes back to starting with a level only
mutations.why: The original shape of both bugs: Speedrun's next puzzle is Classic, and after the daily every win pays the daily hint again.
mutations.expectFailure: Next puzzle turned Speedrun into classic

mutations.name: the level picker behind New game goes back to starting with a level only
mutations.why: A Survival player who picks another level from the header gets Classic at that level.
mutations.expectFailure: the level picker turned Survival into classic

mutations.name: a follow-up is always Classic
mutations.why: The mode is the half of the fix that is easy to drop when the function is tidied: every button would still start a game, just the wrong kind.

mutations.name: a follow-up keeps the daily key
mutations.why: The other half: the mode is right, but the puzzle after the daily still pays the daily hint and rewrites the daily record.
mutations.find: setActiveDailyDateKey(null);   // a follow-up is never the daily puzzle

mutations.name: a follow-up forgets the kind
mutations.why: Added 2026-10-14 with killer Survival (KP-2). The next game takes no kind from the one being played: a killer player picks another level and gets a classic puzzle on a classic clock.
mutations.expectFailure: killer Survival → New game → Lv.2 started classic

mutations.name: the header's Restart sets the classic clock on a killer
mutations.why: The same puzzle starts again with the classic limit: a killer Survival Lv.2 restarted with 6 minutes instead of 13.
